rationale: JD4 regression: the analyzer's declaration switch had no `case "class"`, so a CLASS EXPRESSION produced no extends edge at all — and the differential's heritage walk was gated on the same shape, so both sides were blind and the lane reported agreement on a form neither could see. The oracle moved with the analyzer; an edge emitted on one side alone would have registered as a fabrication. Three binding shapes are pinned because the edge needs a name: a const-bound expression (the binding names it), an expression with its OWN name (that name wins), and an assignment-bound expression (the form a custom-element base is written in). A QUALIFIED base keeps its dotted spelling per the declared JSD19 contract, already pinned by js-member-heritage. The unbound anonymous `export default class extends Base` is pinned as SILENCE: nothing names it, so no edge is derivable — the first cut of this fix pushed `source: ""` and produced a dangling row whose source is not a symbol.

expectRelationships.note: the expression's own name wins over the const binding
qualified base keeps its dotted spelling (JSD19)

forbidRelationships.note: an unbound anonymous class expression names nothing — an edge from the empty string is a dangling row
